modeReason: The states-vs-OpenAI child-safety lawsuit scores 27 (novelty3×magnitude3×breadth3), far above the fresh threshold of 8, so today leads with its own news rather than continuing yesterday's Character.AI bankruptcy story.
phrase: Eight states sued a major AI company over child safety. The same week, one of its own engineers was accused of hiding a recorder in the office toilet paper.
phraseAlternatives: A major AI company was sued by eight states over child safety. Around the same time, one of its engineers was accused of hiding a recorder in the toilet paper.
Eight states say a top chatbot is not safe for children. The company also had to explain a recorder hidden in its own toilet paper.
A big AI lab faced a lawsuit from eight states over child safety, while one of its engineers faced charges for hiding a spy recorder in the bathroom.

brief.concept: The same AI company faces two kinds of judgment on one day: a public lawsuit over child safety, and a private scandal over a spy hidden in its own toilet paper.
brief.metaphor: Courtroom justice and a bug hidden in the bathroom become mirror images of exposure — one public and loud, one literally hidden in the walls.

cast.who: a chatbot robot standing in a courtroom dock
a row of small human officials holding up one shared lawsuit scroll
a startled office worker unrolling a toilet paper roll to reveal a hidden recorder
a judge's gavel hovering mid-swing beside the dock

brief.composition: Two-panel riso-duotone split down the middle by a thin vertical line. Left panel: a chatbot robot stands in a courtroom dock while a row of small human officials hold up one shared lawsuit scroll beneath a raised judge's gavel. Right panel: a startled office worker unrolls a toilet paper roll under a bare meeting-room light, a tiny recorder peeking out of it. No on-image text needed; let the props carry the joke.
